newsitem.title: USA: J&S Partners buys Interactive Gaming stock.
newsitem.headline: J&S Partners buys Interactive Gaming stock.

text.p: Interactive Gaming & Communications Corp said on Tuesday J & S Partners bought 375,000 shares of its stock on September 17, for a total cash investment of $750,000.

J & S Partners is an affiliate of Cambridge Technology Enterprises. Interactive Gaming said in a statement the purchase solidified the previously-announced software development deal between the two companies for Global Casino software.
This software would let consumers with personal computers bet on casino games over the Internet, it said.
